name: dynamic-ticket-pricing
description: Dynamic Ticket Pricing System with ML-powered price predictions

scripts.build-and-package: npm run build && npm run package
scripts.start:all: npm run kill:ports && concurrently --names "frontend,api-gateway,auth,user,admin,payment,cache,email,notification,websocket,analytics,subscription,organizer,qr,scanner,wallet,ml" "npm run dev" "npm run start:api-gateway" "npm run start:authentication-service" "npm run start:user-service" "npm run start:admin-service" "npm run start:payment-service" "npm run start:cache-service" "npm run start:email-service" "npm run start:notification-service" "npm run start:websocket-service" "npm run start:analytics-service" "npm run start:subscription-service" "npm run start:organizer-service" "npm run start:qr-service" "npm run start:scanner-service" "npm run start:wallet-service" "npm run start:ml" --kill-others-on-fail
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd microservices/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../authentication-service && npm install && cd ../user-service && npm install && cd ../admin-service && npm install && cd ../payment-service && npm install && cd ../cache-service && npm install && cd ../email-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install && cd ../websocket-service && npm install && cd ../analytics-service && npm install && cd ../subscription-service && npm install && cd ../organizer-service && npm install && cd ../qr-service && npm install && cd ../scanner-service && npm install && cd ../wallet-service && npm install && cd ../../..
scripts.kill:ports: powershell -Command "$ports = @(5173, 3001, 5000) + (4001..4016); foreach ($p in $ports) { try { $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conn) { $conn | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } } catch {} }; exit 0"
